unit_or_scope: Nearly 9,000 senior executives across seven countries surveyed in 2026

source_title: NBER AI productivity and workforce evidence
direct_observation: The study reports heterogeneous productivity effects, a perceived-versus-measured productivity gap, limited near-term aggregate employment decline and compositional labor reallocation
open_conversion: AI use -> measured work/productivity -> organizational allocation -> worker/customer consequence
evidence_status: working paper; survey and measurement design boundaries apply
next_test: Find firm/task records that observe implementation, realized output, worker control and distribution rather than expectations alone

source_title: ILO Decent Work in the Platform Economy Convention 2026
unit_or_scope: International labour standard for digital platform work
direct_observation: The Convention addresses disclosure of automated systems, their effect on working conditions and access to information when automated decisions affect work
open_conversion: algorithmic decision -> worker notice/explanation -> correction, contestation and voice -> protection or exit
evidence_status: official international standard; implementation and worker outcomes open
next_test: Compare country implementation, platform disclosure, appeal outcomes, worker representation and social protection

open_conversion: dependence -> substitute/recycling investment -> qualified output and cost -> resilience or new dependency
evidence_status: official oversight report; technology readiness and commercial adoption vary
next_test: Track a named mineral/technology through qualification, capacity, price, environmental burden and buyer use

source_title: GAO foreign investment in critical-mineral mines on federal lands
unit_or_scope: 43 claimants/operators associated with critical-mineral mines on federal lands
direct_observation: GAO identifies disclosure gaps and foreign subsidiaries/investment while noting capital and domestic-processing constraints
open_conversion: ownership/control visibility -> extraction/processing -> domestic availability and strategic exposure -> policy response
evidence_status: official oversight report; beneficial control and production effects open
next_test: Join a named operator to ownership, output, processing route, export/use, disruption response and local burden

source_title: World Bank AI pilots to public-service scale
unit_or_scope: Government AI procurement and public-service delivery
direct_observation: The World Bank emphasizes ongoing monitoring, maintenance, testing, data portability, interoperability, auditability, clear ownership and funding beyond an initial AI contract
open_conversion: AI pilot -> procurement/integration -> monitored service -> correction and durable public capacity
evidence_status: institutional guidance; no specific service outcome in this source
next_test: Find a named agency/system with procurement, deployment, error correction, user access and service outcome data

source_title: ILO social dialogue for green and digital transitions
unit_or_scope: Europe and Central Asia institutional experiences
direct_observation: The brief describes social dialogue as a mechanism for managing digital and green transitions, while noting uneven, ad hoc and under-resourced implementation
open_conversion: transition pressure -> employer/worker/state dialogue -> negotiated adaptation -> worker and enterprise continuity
evidence_status: official regional synthesis; selected experiences are not a universal effect
next_test: Compare one country or sector process from dialogue to implemented protection, skills, bargaining or remedy
